reviewed_note: BaSICS (fluid type): ICU patients requiring fluid expansion; registry adults. Served adjusted HR 0.97 (0.90-1.05) printed for 90-day mortality. 10,520 of 11,052 randomised available for analysis, so the served ITT label is imprecise.

population.span: Patients who were admitted to the ICU with at least 1 risk factor for worse outcomes, who required at least 1 fluid expansion, and who were expected to remain in the ICU for more than 24 hours were randomized

estimate.span: By day 90, 1381 of 5230 patients (26.4%) assigned to a balanced solution died vs 1439 of 5290 patients (27.2%) assigned to saline solution (adjusted hazard ratio, 0.97 [95% CI, 0.90-1.05]; P = .47).

ci.span: By day 90, 1381 of 5230 patients (26.4%) assigned to a balanced solution died vs 1439 of 5290 patients (27.2%) assigned to saline solution (adjusted hazard ratio, 0.97 [95% CI, 0.90-1.05]; P = .47).

analysis_set.span: Among 11 052 patients who were randomized, 10 520 (95.2%) were available for the analysis

treatment_strategy.span: Patients were randomly assigned 1:1 to receive either a balanced solution (n = 5522) or 0.9% saline solution (n = 5530) for all intravenous fluids.

entry_population_reading.span: ELIGIBILITY AGE/SEX: minimum age 18 Years | maximum age None | sex ALL

entry_population.extractor_why: The abstract describes critically ill ICU patients requiring fluid expansion; the registry excludes patients younger than 18 years.

extractor_mismatch_note: The served effect and CI match the reported adjusted HR for 90-day mortality. However, the requested estimand is RR; this HR and its CI are not an RR estimate. The served intention-to-treat label is not established by the held sources, which state that 10 520 of 11 052 randomized patients were available for analysis.
